README.md.content:
# Audio app simulator

JavaScript ESM; no dependencies. Product requirements are in docs/product.md.
src/platform/runtime.js is an existing host contract and executable simulator.
The application receives its runtime through createApp(runtime).
Native platform components are maintained by the app shell outside this fixture.

docs/product.md.content:
# Voice sessions

Users start an audio conversation, mute or unmute their microphone, and hang up.
An established conversation continues when they switch to another app or lock
their screen. Hanging up ends microphone use and any ongoing-call indicator.
An unsuccessful connection must leave no ongoing-call indicator or held resources.
This milestone handles outgoing calls only, with one active conversation at a time.
Incoming calls, call history and recording are outside this milestone.
